Name: Star Control - Better Gamepads
Author: focustense
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25257/25257-1739547769-1319892936.png[/img]﻿

[color=#68bb6c][size=3][i][b]The only controller mod you'll ever need.[/b][/i][/size][/color][color=#f6b26b]*[/color]

[line]

Star Control—short for [color=#d26221][b]Star[/b][/color]dew [color=#68bb6c][b]Control[/b][/color]lers—is a total redesign of Stardew Valley's serviceable but clunky controller input system.

What does "total redesign" mean? A picture is worth a thousand words, so we'll lead with those; instead of being limited to this:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/spPVGfWC/screenshot-vanilla-toolbar.png[/img]

You have access to this:

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/25257/25257-1739547482-1626090648.png[/img]

[color=#68bb6c][size=5]Features[/size][/color]

Compared to vanilla Stardew controls, in Star Control:

[list][*]Every button has a unique and useful function.
[*](Almost) every input is configurable and remappable.
[*]You can use items directly from the menus, instead of having to press several buttons to select, use and then confirm.
[*]Most modded features can be accessed and used with your gamepad, even if the mod author didn't design for it.
[/list]
The key features are:

[list][*][url=https://focustense.github.io/StardewControllers/controller-hud/#pie-menus]Pie Menus[/url] for your Inventory and Mod Actions that can be navigated with the analog stick;
[*]Configurable [url=https://focustense.github.io/StardewControllers/controller-hud/#quick-actions]Quick Action[/url] slots that can be activated with a single button press, without using the stick, and remember your setting even when the item is no longer in your inventory or the action is no longer possible;
[*]Configurable [url=https://focustense.github.io/StardewControllers/instant-actions/]Instant Actions[/url], sometimes called "Zelda-style" controls, in which you can bind a specific tool or item to a controller button to perform its action; for example, [img]https://i.ibb.co/HTbm9dx3/x.png[/img] to swing with pickaxe, [img]https://i.ibb.co/bjN8yfDZ/y.png[/img] to slash with sword, and [img]https://i.ibb.co/TB1FPW1r/b.png[/img] to chop with axe. The sky's the limit.
[*]An expansive in-game [url=https://focustense.github.io/StardewControllers/configuration/]configuration system[/url] that can customize nearly every aspect of the mod and is itself designed for gamepad navigation.
[/list]
[color=#68bb6c][size=5]Documentation[/size][/color]

User and integrator documentation, including all content on this page, is available at the [url=https://focustense.github.io/StardewControllers/]Star Control Docs[/url].

[color=#68bb6c][size=5]Requirements[/size][/color]

Using Star Control requires:

[list][*]A valid Stardew Valley install with SMAPI and Stardew UI (see Setup below);
[*]Stardew-compatible gamepad controller, such as any Xbox controller;
[*]Screen resolution or window size of at least 1080p (1920x1080). [color=#ff6666]720p resolution, or 1080p resolution with high UI scale, is not and will not be supported in some configuration menus.[/color]
[/list]
[color=#68bb6c][size=5]Setup[/size][/color]

[color=#ff9999][b][size=4]IMPORTANT:[/size][/b] Users of [font=Courier New]RadialMenu 0.2.2[/font] or earlier [b]must manually uninstall [font=Courier New]RadialMenu[/font][/b] before installing Star Control, i.e. delete the [font=Courier New]RadialMenu[/font] folder from the Mods directory and/or mod manager, or move it to a backup location. Otherwise, the two mods may conflict and neither mod will function correctly.

Star Control is [b]not backward-compatible[/b] with clients of the older Radial Menu API. Mods designed to work with the older Radial Menu mod, such as Sword and Sorcery, will not work with Star Control until they receive updates. Please ensure that your other mods are compatible with the new version before upgrading.[/color]

Star Control works out of the box, though many of its more powerful features require additional setup. These steps will get you up and running; afterward, head on over to the [url=https://focustense.github.io/StardewControllers/configuration/]configuration[/url] pages to learn how to customize.

Installation steps:

[list=1][*]Install [url=https://smapio.io/]SMAPI[/url] and set up your game for mods, per the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Modding: Player's Guide[/url] instructions.
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28870]Stardew UI[/url].
[*]Download the main file from the Files tab.
[*]Open the .zip file and extract the [font=Courier New][color=#4cae4f]StarControl[/color][/font] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Mods[/font] folder. You can also use a mod manager such as Stardrop.
[*]Launch the game and load a save.
[/list]
Basic controls once the mod is installed (all can be customized):

[list][*]Hold [img]https://i.ibb.co/d0SZzt3F/left-trigger.png[/img] to open the Inventory Pie Menu,
[*]Hold [img]https://i.ibb.co/G3QrRN2L/right-trigger.png[/img] to open the Mod Actions menu, which initially will only have one item, the [url=https://focustense.github.io/StardewControllers/configuration/]Star Control Settings[/url].
[*]With either menu open, use [img]https://i.ibb.co/DHQQKbTq/left-analog.png[/img] to focus an item. The game is paused during selection (except in co-op/multiplayer).
[*]When an item is focused (highlighted), press [img]https://i.ibb.co/HfLYR9CJ/a.png[/img] to use it or [img]https://i.ibb.co/HTbm9dx3/x.png[/img] to select (hold) it.
[*]If a menu has multiple pages, use [img]https://i.ibb.co/qTCJx6V/left-button.png[/img] and [img]https://i.ibb.co/G3QrRN2L/right-trigger.png[/img] to navigate while the menu is open.
[*]Press [img]https://i.ibb.co/gLxx0cc6/left-stick.png[/img] during gameplay to open the Instant Actions menu and set single-button actions.
[/list]
[color=#68bb6c][size=5]Contact[/size][/color]

Found a bug, or have questions? You can reach the author in one of the following ways:

[list][*]Ping [b]@focustense[/b] in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord[/url] or start a thread in [font=Courier New]#modded-tech-support[/font].
[*]Start a [url=https://github.com/focustense/StardewControllers/discussions]discussion[/url] or create an [url=https://github.com/focustense/StardewControllers/issues]issue[/url] on the project's GitHub.
[/list]
[b]All bug reports require a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] to investigate. Please turn on the "Everything" option in the mod's [url=https://focustense.github.io/StardewControllers/configuration/#debug]debug settings[/url] while capturing your log; don't forget to turn it off afterwards as it produces a large amount of output.[/b]
